# Lavendar Lewis

## Overview

- **Age:** presumed 45  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P48](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0048)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P0](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0000)</sub>
- **Family:** [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) (spouse), [Irving](../character/irving.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Lavendar Lewis is a little lady with an almost girlish, pink-cheeked face featuring dimples, sweet lips, and pretty cheeks. She has sweet, big wood-brown eyes with little golden glints in them. Her snow-white hair is remarkably thick and beautifully wavy, carefully styled in becoming puffs and coils, and she possesses pretty hands.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P25](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0025), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P34](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0034), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029)_

## Personality

Lavendar Lewis copes with life by engaging in imagination, maintaining that she could not live at times without pretending things.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)_

## History

Miss Lavendar Lewis was an eccentric woman living at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) who hired little [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) Bowman after her mother died ten years prior. One October, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) stumbled upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where Miss Lavendar entertained them with tea and demonstrated the magical echoes of her home, though she was noticeably shaken when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mentioned [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). Miss Lavendar later confided in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her past romance and broken engagement with Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), after which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) brought [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) to meet her. Following a note delivered by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Stephen visited [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), leading to their joyful reconciliation and eventual marriage. Time later, during a summer visit from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Miss Lavendar cautioned her that she and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) were meant for each other.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), +23 more_

## Background by volume

**Volume 2**

- hired little Charlotta Bowman after her mother died ten years earlier  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- jilted by Stephen Irving after a quarrel  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- named Lavendar by her father because he was fond of lavendar  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>
- quarreled with Stephen Irving and broke off their engagement  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>
- used to be engaged to Stephen Irving when young  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036)</sub>

## Quotes

> "But oh, won’t you stay and have tea with me? Please, do. Mr. Kimball’s will have tea over before you get there. And Charlotta the Fourth and I will be so glad to have you."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)

> "I love them myself. They are very good company . . . with a little pretending. On calm evenings Charlotta the Fourth and I often sit out here and amuse ourselves with them. Charlotta, take back the horn and hang it carefully in its place."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P74](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0074)

> "It gave me a shock to hear about Stephen’s son that first day you were here, Anne. I’ve never been able to mention him to you since, but I’ve wanted to know all about him. What sort of a boy is he?"
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P21](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0021)

> "Oh, I’m not so old as I thought . . . and I don’t need a single blue pill! Girls, when you come back with your strawberries we’ll have tea out here under the silver poplar. I’ll have it all ready for you with home-grown cream."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P36](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0036)

> "I’m wholesomely ashamed to think that a new dress . . . even it is a forget-me-not organdy . . . should exhilarate me so, when a good conscience and an extra contribution to Foreign Missions couldn’t do it."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P19](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0019)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--lavendar-lewis.md)

Lavendar Lewis considers [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) a very dear friend and kindred spirit after meeting her when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally stumbled upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Lavendar confides in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her past romance and broken engagement with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) subsequently introduces her to Stephen's son. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) also helps Lavendar prepare for her eventual reunion with Stephen.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +7 more_

- Friend of — very dear friend and kindred spirit  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P31](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0031), [v3 ch.People P22](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0022)</sub>

### [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta the Fourth serves as Lavendar's maid at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Lavendar entertains guests alongside [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), while [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) keeps a watchful eye on Lavendar's mood and confides her concerns to friends when Lavendar seems melancholic. [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) also assists in domestic preparations during key moments in Lavendar's life.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +15 more_

- Commands — employer/master to handmaiden  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044)</sub>

### [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--stephen-irving.md)

[Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) is Lavendar's husband, following a long separation after a broken engagement twenty-five years prior. After Stephen sends a note initiating a visit to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), the two reconcile while walking in the garden and are soon after married in a ceremony at her home.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P17](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0017), +12 more_

- Romantically involved with — formerly engaged twenty-five years ago  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- Spouse of — married wife  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030)</sub>

### [Irving](../character/irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/irving--lavendar-lewis.md)

Lavendar is married to Mr. [Irving](../character/irving.md). Prior to their marriage, she shared the history of her broken engagement to him with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), but the two later wed in a ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge).

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P15](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0015), +7 more_

- Spouse of (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Change P2](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0002), [v3 ch.Again P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048)</sub>
